orion_dividends.method: Read A. The account is chosen by the rule: in the newest transaction partition, among accounts holding a dividend or income transaction (status Complete; the transaction types whose description names dividend, income or interest, tax types excluded), the account whose sha256 of its id (utf-8, hex digest) sorts lowest. The window is the longest unbroken run of days in which the positions partitions and the client's performance rows both exist and the account holds a positive market value; returns run over the days after the window's first day. The newest performance partition carries the cumulative series, so one read serves the window. Daily return is end market value minus the day's external flows, over start market value, minus one. External flows are the ratified taxonomy's client-flow types by direction (contributions in, distributions out); trades, fees and taxes stay in value. The WITHOUT figure also removes, on their day, the taxonomy's Return-bucket income receipts (dividend to cash, interest paid in cash, interest paid). Daily returns are linked over the window for each figure. The reported figure is the client's performance factor read as an index level: the last window day over the first. The answer is YES when the reported figure sits within a tolerance of the WITH figure and outside it for the WITHOUT figure; the tolerance is a quarter of the gap between the two computed figures, and never less than the factor's resolution. NO is the reverse; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise, when no dividend flow lies in the window, or when the gap is below the resolution. The same test over all accounts of the client together returned the same answer.
orion_dividends.basis_words: The reported window return sits within the tolerance of the with-income figure and outside it for the without-income figure, at account level and at client level. It lies just beyond the with-income figure, not between the two figures. Limits: the performance table is keyed by client and this client holds two accounts; reinvested income is not removed in the without figure, because the ratified taxonomy classes reinvestment as value-neutral; in-kind transfers are not separately valued. Counts and words only; no figure is recorded.

eclipse_lots.lots_words: Lot-level detail is not available for this account yet.
eclipse_lots.method: Every dated partition of the four silver tables was opened and its column names matched for lot-level tokens (lot, acquisition, cost basis, open date); no column carries a lot field, so no row does. The reconstructed objects (7) and the meta objects (1449) were checked by name and by key; none carries a lot key.

reads.s3_reads_basis: LIST and GET calls: three full runs of the script at 1254 each, plus about sixty exploratory listing and schema calls made before them under the same two prefixes.
